name: Plain of Weeping
text: Plain of Weeping and Plain of Reckoning are English renderings of Mag Tuired. Both phrases lead readers to the article on Mag Tuired, which carries the full record. The battle tales of that place sit with the Tuatha Dé Danann tradition.
